name: Human Protein Atlas v25.1: tissue and cell-type RNA expression and protein subcellular location
maintainer: The Human Protein Atlas consortium (Science for Life Laboratory, Sweden)

version.value: Human Protein Atlas version 25.1 (the download page names the version; the URLs serve the current release); files dated 2025-11-06 and 2025-12-12

scope: Three gene-level tables of the atlas: consensus RNA expression (nTPM) in 51 tissues for 20,162 genes; RNA expression (nCPM) of the same genes in 154 single-cell types; and the subcellular location of proteins for 13,603 genes with a reliability category (Enhanced, Supported, Approved, Uncertain). The atlas also holds antibody-based tissue and cancer protein data, mass-spectrometry, blood, brain, cell-line and interaction data that are not fetched.
mapping_methods: Rows are keyed by Ensembl gene id without a version, so they join to the MANE summary, the Ensembl annotation and Open Targets after stripping versions elsewhere.

quantitative.summary: Normalised RNA expression per gene and tissue or cell type (nTPM, nCPM) and categorical protein-location reliability.
quantitative.uncertainty: none per value; reliability category for locations

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International for all copyrightable parts of the Human Protein Atlas; data subject to third-party constraints may also be included, and the licence page lists external sources with other licences (HPA licence and citation page, verified live).
licence.redistribution: Attribution required; check the third-party licences listed on the HPA page before redistributing derived tables

update_frequency: Annual versions (the release history is linked from the download page).
coverage_limitations: Gene-level summaries: no allele-specific or isoform-resolved information
The consensus tissue table has 1,026,292 gene-tissue values for 20,162 genes and 51 tissues (0.998 of all pairs); absent pairs are absent, not zero
Bulk-tissue values average over the cell types present; the single-cell-type table is the cell-resolved view
known_omissions: The antibody-based protein expression, pathology, blood, brain-region, cell-line, immune-cell, mass-spectrometry and interaction tables, and the full proteinatlas.tsv/json/xml summaries, are not fetched
The separate HPA-only and GTEx-only RNA tables are not fetched; the GTEx expression files are held through the gtex source

reuse_decision.rationale: Tissue and cell-type specificity of gene expression decides whether a regulatory or loss-of-function mechanism is plausible in a tissue of interest, and subcellular location bears on protein-level mechanisms. The three tables are small (22 MB) and fill the cell-type-resolved and protein-localisation gaps that GTEx bulk tissue and Open Targets baseline expression leave.

status.notes: Plain HTTPS downloads; no checksum is published, so size and SHA-256 are pinned. The URLs always serve the current release.

unverified_fields: how the consensus expression levels are computed (the page lists the HPA, GTEx and consensus RNA datasets separately; the combination method was not read)
licences of the external sources that the licence page lists

mechanism_evidence.note: tissue and cell-type resolved RNA expression of the gene

evidence_profile.biological_context: RNA sequencing of tissues and single-cell types, normalised per gene, and protein localisation by immunofluorescence imaging of cultured cell lines (the download page lists the image-based location data). Expression is a property of the sampled tissue or cell type and its donors.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Measured expression and localisation summarised per gene; reliability categories grade the localisation evidence. The consensus RNA table combines datasets (see unverified fields), so it is not independent of GTEx.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low. It shows where a gene is expressed or its protein found, which bears on whether a tissue-specific regulatory or loss-of-function mechanism is plausible; it says nothing about the effect of any allele.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: None directly; tissue specificity informs which tissues could manifest an effect.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A gene without a value in a tissue or cell type is not shown to be silent there: detection limits, dilution in bulk tissue and tissues or states that were not sampled apply. A gene absent from the localisation table was not localised (13,603 genes), not shown to be non-localised.

overlaps_with_sources.note: the consensus tissue RNA table is described on the download page beside separate HPA and GTEx RNA tables; do not count GTEx expression twice (the combination method was not read)
